title: The Fortnite Kid
subtitle: One boy. One hundred players. No way home except a Victory Royale.
version_note: A novel set in Chapter 7 Season 4 (Override), during Fortnitemares and the v42.40 update. Game details checked 16 October 2026.
description: An unofficial Fortnite fan novel. At five o'clock one Sunday morning in Sydney, Billy logs in for the Trick or Treat Sprite Power Hour and gets pulled into the Island for real. To get home he has to level himself up like a Sprite, and win.
glossary_blurb: Every Word Watch word in the book, from A to Z. Billy collects Sprites; you can collect words. Try to use five of these before the weekend.
